I have only 0.20 hectares here and it is rented land, so I will not waste money buying chemical fertilizer for beans when my maize plot needs it more. I will put manure on the plot to help the soil, and I will use bean seed I kept from last season. I will do the work with my family, and I do not have money to hire ganyu labor for this small plot. We do not irrigate here in Kasungu; we wait for the rains.
